incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: sustained p95 token latency spike for redwood-7b in eu-central-1. Alert threshold crossed: p95 > 1.0s for 7 minutes.

maya_oncall: oncall here, looking at dashboard. which customers are impacted?

kelly_prod: seeing elevated 504s from MetricsHub and ChatFlow. Customer error rate up ~2.2% on /v1/generate.

ira_sre: Queue depth across the pool is high. Continuous batching window is accumulating mixed short+long requests -> big tail. Also a recent autoscaler tweak bumped worker concurrency earlier today.

josh_runtime: I pulled traces: long-context requests (>=3000 tokens) are sitting in batches and blocking smaller requests. KV-cache churn visible too. Suspect batching params need to be tightened ASAP.

maya_oncall: immediate goals: 1) bring p95 < 700ms, 2) limit customer visible errors, 3) avoid full rollback if possible. Proposed live mitigations?

josh_runtime: quick fixes we can push now: reduce continuous batching wait and batch token cap, set per-tenant token rate limits for noisy tenants, and flip streaming off for tenants with high concurrency. Also enable sequence-based routing to separate long-sequence traffic.

ira_sre: Agree. Add traffic shaping: reduce quotas for non-prod keys and noisy tenants. That gives immediate queue relief.

maya_oncall: ok propose patch to canary first:

```
PATCH /runtime/config
{
  "continuous_batching": {
    "max_wait_ms": "30",         # was 80
    "max_tokens_per_batch": "800", # was 4096
    "max_concurrent_batches": "2" # was 5
  }
}
```

josh_runtime: LGTM. I'll apply to runtime-canary-2 (4 nodes). Also adding route rule: `route if seq_len > 2048 -> longseq-pool` so they don't mix.

deploy-bot: config-update: starting rollout to runtime-canary-2 (4 nodes). audit-id=AU-2003-01.

ira_sre: while canary rolls, set tenant caps: `quotactl set MetricsHub --qps 4 --tokens_per_min 12000` and `quotactl set ChatFlow --qps 5`. That should cut their queue share.

kelly_prod: I'll notify CS and affected customers: short note prepared saying "temporary throttles and batching changes to improve latency; you may see lower throughput on very long requests." Posting now.

deploy-bot: runtime-canary-2: patch applied to 4 nodes. Observability: p95 on canary nodes dropped 1.1s -> 620ms within 50s. No error spike on canary.

maya_oncall: good. josh, apply streaming flag off for MetricsHub and ChatFlow?

josh_runtime: doing: `featurectl set streaming MetricsHub false` and `featurectl set streaming ChatFlow false` -> applied.

deploy-bot: feature-flag-change: streaming toggled for MetricsHub by josh_runtime at 2003007965.

ira_sre: canary queue depth down ~58%. Traces show fewer big batches and much lower head-of-line blocking.

josh_runtime: rolling to eu-central-1 pool with staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 90s windows.

deploy-bot: rollout: eu-central-1 10% -> 50% -> 100% complete. audit-id=AU-2003-02.

kelly_prod: Customer update posted to tickets and status page. Customers responded that timeouts reduced for most calls; a couple note throughput lower for long jobs.

ira_sre: Global p95 now ~490ms. Error rate returned near baseline. MetricsHub and ChatFlow throughput reduced but stable.

maya_oncall: excellent. Actions: 1) keep mitigations for 30 minutes while we investigate root cause, 2) run bench replay focused on long-seq traffic and KV-cache settings, 3) follow-up postmortem. Anyone object to keeping config for 30m?

josh_runtime: no objections. I'll capture the kernel patch diff from today's deploy and run bench on a staging cluster. If bench passes with sequence-lane enabled, we can attempt a controlled increase of batch tokens but keep laneing enforced.

ira_sre: I'll add an automation to run when top-tenant-queue-share > 35%: auto-decrease max_wait_ms to 25 and apply tenant throttles. Will add to runbook.

maya_oncall: creating INC-2026-0920 and assigning to josh_runtime for root cause. Leaving channel open for handoff to night oncall @ 2003008200.

deploy-bot: audit-log: applied runtime config and tenant quotas by josh_runtime at 2003007970.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0920 mitigated -> monitoring. Owner: maya_oncall.

maya_oncall: handing off to night. If anything regresses, please reopen channel. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
